notes: two taḥwīl branches (حامد → سفيان; مسدد → يحيى) meet at ابن عجلان: the names written once after the last ح are the shared tail (rule 3)
«سمع عياضا» is a link (rule 5); the Companion is أبو سعيد
«هذا حديث يحيى زاد سفيان» gives the wording addition of Sufyan; Abu Dawud's remark on Ibn Uyayna's mistake is not a link
bare سفيان is kept as written
